title: Download from a link
field.linkHint: The computer downloads the link itself. You can close this page; the download keeps going. Up to 100 GiB and 12 hours. The computer keeps the link in its download history and logs.
field.name: Save as
field.nameHint: If the name is taken, the computer keeps both and adds a number.
bad.scheme: Paste a link that starts with http:// or https://.
bad.computer: Copying from one of your computers isn't available here yet. Paste a link from another site.
bad.unknown: This link can't be checked now.
bad.name: Use a name without / or \, not . or .., at most 255 characters.
kit.old: Update the Hoody Kit on {{computer}} to use this.
kit.failed: Couldn't check the Hoody Kit on {{computer}}.
off.top: Open a folder to download into.
result.refused: Nothing was started: the computer refused it.
result.CHANGES_OFF: Changes are turned off in this Hub session.
result.FILE_PATH_BUSY: Nothing was started: this folder is busy. Try again in a moment.
result.FORBIDDEN: Nothing was started: this computer's files program doesn't download links, or not into this folder.
result.NOT_FOUND: Nothing was started: this folder isn't there any more.
result.busy: Nothing was started: too many downloads are running on {{computer}}. Try again later.
result.notSent: Nothing was sent: this browser couldn't keep a record of it first. Try again.
result.HELD: Nothing was sent: this browser is still tracking an earlier send. Try again.
result.FULL: Nothing was sent: too many unresolved transfers. Check them first.
line.tracking: The Hub keeps this download until it is checked. {{computer}} remembers its id for 7 days.
line.runningBusy: Renames, deletes and copies in {{folder}} wait until it ends.
line.unreadable: A link download on {{computer}} is tracked but can't be read.
line.notSentBusy: {{name}} was not sent: too many downloads were running on {{computer}}.
check.notFound: {{computer}} has no record of it yet. It may still arrive; check again later. Only the tab that sent it can send it again.
check.tooOld: Too old to check by id; look in {{folder}}.
check.resent: Sent again with the same id; it still may have gone through.
cancelFailed: Couldn't cancel. The download may still be running.
stopBody: {{computer}} may have accepted the download of {{name}} into {{folder}}. If you stop tracking, the Hub won't check it again; look for the file there.
stopFailed: Couldn't stop tracking it. Try again.
line.unread: Its progress can't be read now; it may still be running.
